claim_en: THE THANKSGIVING'S CLASS: A thank-offering slaughtered as a peace-offering is VALID; the reverse is not ('This is the law'). The school of R. Yishmael NAMES Hermeneutical Principle 11: departed-for-a-new-teaching (the loaves), restored to its category by the verse — hand-laying, libations, waving all inherited. FUNDING: an unqualified vow comes from mundane money only; 'from the tithe' must be said; the loaves RIDE the offering's source and cannot be severed downward; whatever is obligatory comes only from mundane money (the Pesach likening, Deut 16:2), and libations always.

THE OIL COMPUTE AND THE SINAI CONSTANT: R. Akiva reads the doubled 'with oil' by rule — increase after increase DECREASES (half a log), the third mention increases again (not blind thirds): a quarter to the soaked kind, a quarter split between cakes and wafers (the wafers anointed in the form of the Greek letter chi, R. Shimon b. Yehudah). And R. ELAZAR B. AZARYAH'S RECORDED DISSENT SELF-LABELS THE DATA CHANNEL: the half log of the thanksgiving, the quarter log of the Nazirite, the eleven days between menstrual periods — 'A HALACHAH TO MOSES ON SINAI': transmitted constants, not derivations — the two-channel doctrine in the Sifra's own row.

THE LOAF COMPUTE: The leavened measure — TEN tenth-measures — is fixed by the leavened-leavened identity with the two loaves (one tenth per loaf; the show-bread counter resolved by resemblance and Lev 23:17's redundant 'shall you bring'); the count TEN is read off the extra letter yod in 'shall they be' (its numerical value); the unleavened matches the leavened (ten more, over three kinds — three and a third each, three loaves per tenth): FORTY loaves, the priest taking one of each kind — four of forty — whole loaves, offerings kept equal, one-of-ten by the terumah identity with the tithe-gift (Num 18:29) sealed by gezeirah shavah.

THE BREAD'S COMMIT POINT: The bread is consecrated only once its surface CRUSTS in the oven, and only BY THE SLAUGHTER of the animal as a thank-offering — the ruled matrix: slaughtered as-such but sprinkled not-as-such is 'consecrated and not consecrated' (Rebbi) against R. Eliezer b. R. Shimon's both-or-nothing (dual-track). Loaves attach PER offering; offspring, exchanges, and substitutes are sacrificed WITHOUT loaves; of a lost-and-found pair, either is offered with the loaves; the Nazirite's ram joins at ten Jerusalem kavim and a quarter log — with unleavened, not soaked, bread.

THE EATING WINDOWS: ONE DAY AND A NIGHT: the thanksgiving with its BREAD, its offspring and substitutes, the sin- and guilt-offerings, the Nazirite's, the Pesach surplus. TWO DAYS AND ONE NIGHT: vow and gift peace-offerings, the festival offering in its four forms, substitutes, firstborn, tithe — and the fourteenth-of-Nissan festival offering by Deut 16:4's second morning. TWIN INTENT LAWS by one move: the redundant eating verses (Lev 22:29-30; 19:5-6) transfer to the SLAUGHTER — each class is slaughtered on the thought of its own window. claim_en: THE REJECTION MACHINE: The verse speaks of the THOUGHT, not the deed — R. Eliezer's 'incline your ear' with R. Akiva's proof that the validated offering cannot be retro-unfitted: the unfitness enters AT THE OFFERING. The thought carries at services UPON WHICH ATONEMENT IS CONTINGENT — slaughter, reception, sprinkling — not at disposal or fat-burning; the blood-carrying is a recorded three-way (R. Meir / R. Shimon / R. Elazar's positional rule). TWO EATINGS — for the man and for the altar — both carry it; one-day offerings take it on second-day thought (the eaten-eaten seal); out-of-PLACE thought unfits but karet rides TIME only; the PERMITTERS criterion bounds the whole machine (no permit...

THE FLESH'S TUMAH LAW: Consecrated flesh takes tumah by TOUCH, not carrying (the red-heifer a-fortiori refuted); all grades transmit; ALL leftover burns — the named-in-the-row building-principle (binyan av, Hermeneutical Principle 3) from the investiture's own burn clause (Exod 29:34); the burn catalog is the unfitness catalog; but 'for it is holy' excludes what died, miscarried, or became tamei OUTSIDE — buried, not burned. A projected limb taints only its projecting part; the ruled procedure: on a Pesach — cut to the bone, strip to the joint, sever (no bone-breaking); elsewhere — chop anywhere.

source: Sifra, Tzav, Chapter 14; Sifra, Tzav, Section 9
claim_en: LIABILITY BEGINS AT THE SPRINKLING: Everyone clean eats (not the owner only); tumah-karet attaches only to flesh PERMITTED to the clean — after its permitters act; include what left or overstayed (each had a time of fitness), exclude the rejected (it never had one) — the time-of-fitness criterion's third seat; the one tamei BEFORE the sprinkling is still liable after it, because the head-plate's acceptance makes the sprinkling permit the flesh; and what was slaughtered FOR THE UNCLEAN (the congregational-tumah Pesach) carries no liability for its unclean eaters — with the pushed-in zavim and lepers indexed to the dead-body class (Num 5:2).

THE BODY'S TUMAH, FOUR WAYS: 'His tumah upon him' means the BODY's — by the gezeirah shavah on the repeated word with Num 19:13, by Rebbi's person-linkage, by R. Chiyya's number mismatch (plural offerings, singular tumah), by the Others' departable-tumah criterion: four recorded routes to one law, carried in parallel — and Onkelos renders the possessive accordingly. The karet clause excludes the forced, the unwitting, and the mistaken; the people remain at peace.

THE TWO MACHINES COMPARED: The teacher sets the rejection machine and the tumah machine side by side in one recorded argument: rejection — one awareness, a standard offering, nothing of its class permitted, PERMITTERS-BOUND; tumah — two awarenesses, a sliding-scale offering, its class permitted at congregational tumah, and reaching even the no-permitter items through Lev 22:3. The eater's own tumah also transmits by touch not carrying; both the lesser and graver source lists are written because each blocks a wrong inference; blood is excluded (forbidden in itself; R.
